answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 103 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an atlas bet on surviving 103 epochs of grading, and every horizon settlement recomputes the terrace schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 38 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
